# Appendix

```{r}
files <- tibble::tibble(
  File=c("summary.tsv","ranking.tsv","top20.tsv","filtered_inputs.tsv","rank_change.tsv","rank_change_largest.tsv",
         "rank_change_top20_union.tsv","seed_contributions.tsv","direct_heat_flow.tsv"),
  Description=c("Run-level metrics.","Complete prioritized ranking.","Top-ranked candidates.",
                "Input regions excluded because they did not overlap any network node.",
                "Input-score rank versus final-score rank.","Top 20 largest absolute rank changes.",
                "Union of input-score Top20 and final-score Top20.",
                "Seed-level contribution decomposition for candidate-driving nodes.",
                "Estimated direct heat outflow from candidate-driving nodes."))%>%
  mutate(Available=file.exists(file.path(report_dir,File)),
         Link=ifelse(Available,sprintf('<a href="%s">%s</a>',File,File),""))
DT::datatable(files,escape=FALSE,rownames=FALSE,options=list(pageLength=20,scrollX=TRUE))
```
